FLASHCARD · UPPERCASE ALPHABET · AGES 3–4 YEARS

Uppercase Letter M Flashcard

The big letter M on its own card — one bright capital shape on a clean page, so all your child’s eyes see is the letter itself.

← Letter LPrevious cardLetter N →Next card

Say it together

“This is the big letter M. Say its name — “M!””

Say it naturally, then wait. Whatever comes back — the letter, the word, a point, a giggle — is the right answer.

Try this

After the card, hunt for the letter: “can you find a big M on the cereal box?” Letters spotted on real things around the house stick better than any printable.
